info.name: Consents Account On File Account Controls (New) Account Controls (New) Transactions Raw Data API

params.name: account_id
params.description: The account_id used to fetch requested data

params.name: async
params.description: When true the API will return a results_id which can be fetched from the /data/v2/results endpoint when ready. **Note: it's recommended to use the sync flow (async=false) for all requests by adapting the [data workflow](https://docs.leantech.me/docs/data-workflow) for connected entities.**

params.name: page
params.description: The page you're requesting - returns page 0 of a response if not specified.

params.name: size
params.description: The number of objects you want to return as a page size.

params.name: entity_id
params.description: The entity_id you're querying for, which is created by LinkSDK `.connect()` function.

params.name: meta
params.description: Additional data you would like to store against the request. Example: {"foo": "val"}

params.name: start_date
params.description: The start date in UTC (in the format YYYY-MM-DD) you want to query transactions for.

params.name: end_date
params.description: The end date in UTC (in the format YYYY-MM-DD) you want to query transactions for.

items.docs: The `Get Transactions `endpoint retrieves a list of historical transactions associated with a specific bank account linked by a user via LinkSDK, identified by both the entity_id and the account_id. Each transaction object contains fields such as amount, status, balance after each transaction, transaction category and type, and additional information. Requires an active entity with the `transactions` permission to use.
